entries.title: Hebrews 3:1
segments: ¶Therefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:2
segments: who was faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also [was faithful] in all His house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:3
segments: For this One has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as He who built the house has more honor than the house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:4
segments: For every house is built by someone, but He who built all things [is] God.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:5
segments: And Moses indeed [was] faithful in all His house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which would be spoken [afterward],

entries.title: Hebrews 3:6
segments: but Christ as a Son over His own house, whose house we are if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:7
segments: ¶Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you will hear His voice,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:8
segments: Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, In the day of trial in the wilderness,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:9
segments: Where your fathers tested Me, tried Me, And saw My works forty years.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:10
segments: Therefore I was angry with that generation, And said, 'They always go astray in [their] heart, And they have not known My ways.'

entries.title: Hebrews 3:11
segments: So I swore in My wrath, 'They shall not enter My rest.'"

entries.title: Hebrews 3:12
segments: Beware, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief in departing from the living God;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:13
segments: but exhort one another daily, while it is called "Today," lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:14
segments: For we have become partakers of Christ if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to the end,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:15
segments: while it is said: "Today, if you will hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion."

entries.title: Hebrews 3:16
segments: For who, having heard, rebelled? Indeed, [was it] not all who came out of Egypt, [led] by Moses?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:17
segments: Now with whom was He angry forty years? [Was it] not with those who sinned, whose corpses fell in the wilderness?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:18
segments: And to whom did He swear that they would not enter His rest, but to those who did not obey?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:19
segments: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
